translation_notes: Both Namespace() calls (basens, opcuans) are assigned straight to self.basens/self.opcuans and outlive the block: `@prefix` has no run-time object (INSTRUCTIONS.md #1, #5), so a self.basens = Namespace(...) that must be readable from other methods of the TestCase cannot become `@prefix ns: <...> .` -- there is nothing to store on self. Kept as plain Namespace(...) calls, unchanged from original.py.

Context shim added: `from lib.shacl import Shacl, Validation` is unreachable outside the IndustryFusion/DigitalTwin repo, so both original.py and translated.ldpy import Shacl/Validation from context_shim.py instead (minimal constructor that records its four arguments, matching how setUp uses it) -- see AGENT_BATCH.md's shim protocol.

driver.py: setUp(self) only mutates attributes on `self`; a fresh instance per side stands in for the TestCase, but its Graph() attribute (data_graph, and shacl.data_graph) gets a fresh BNode identifier per instantiation, so plain __eq__/SimpleNamespace comparison would report a false mismatch between two runs of identical code. The driver defines a small comparable stand-in whose __eq__ recurses through attributes and reduces any nested Graph to graphs_isomorphic() before comparing -- no change to original.py/translated.ldpy semantics, purely a comparison detail.
